Name: Cybereinforce
Author: Cybeurope - support@cybeurope.com
Description: The [Cybereinforce](https://cybereinforce.com) solution for Microsoft Sentinel brings events from every Cybereinforce product into Sentinel: Browser protection (URL blocks, threat-intelligence matches, devices, rules), Email Security, Host Enforcement, Brand Protection and platform audit events, told apart by the Product column. The data connector lets Microsoft Sentinel collect new events every 5 minutes with a single Cybereinforce MicrosoftToken. The solution also includes a workbook for SOC operational visibility and analytics rules covering URL enforcement, threat-intel matches, device risk patterns, and license/capacity health.
WorkbookDescription: Operational visibility for SOC teams: ingestion health, URL blocks, audit activity, and IOC synchronization.
